rules.from: Seeks continuity of the specific records entrusted to this person, rather than new authority.
rules.to: Sets the agenda order of the Suseo Station members' assembly from the mediator's seat, so that joint bargaining does not split into per-power partition and subjugation.

rules.from: Seeks continuity of the specific records entrusted to this person, rather than new authority.
rules.to: Turns recommendations of skilled staff for the Suseo Station Union Vehicle Workshop into public skill tests, breaking the factions' monopoly on recommendations at the members' assembly.

rules.from: Loss of the assigned records or a blocked handover may heighten concern about accountability.
rules.to: That the skills review committee becomes a hostage window that hands technicians over to the powers.

rules.from: Seeks continuity of the specific records entrusted to this person, rather than new authority.
rules.to: Turns recommendations of skilled staff for the Suseo Station Union Vehicle Workshop into public skill tests and maintenance signatures, breaking the factions' monopoly on recommendations at the members' assembly.

rules.from: Loss of the assigned records or a blocked handover may heighten concern about accountability.
rules.to: That the repair yard becomes a hostage window that hands technicians over to the powers and the tools become subcontractors of a seal.

rules.from: Seeks continuity of the specific records entrusted to this person, rather than new authority.
rules.to: Keeps on-site care during the Suseo Station members' assembly as the floor of joint bargaining, so that per-power partition and subjugation cannot buy the sickbeds.

rules.from: Seeks continuity of the specific records entrusted to this person, rather than new authority.

rules.from: Loss of the assigned records or a blocked handover may heighten concern about accountability.
rules.to: That the patrol meets the Amsa patrol train and a single exchange of fire turns joint bargaining into war.

rules.from: Seeks continuity of the specific records entrusted to this person, rather than new authority.
rules.to: Ties the Suseo Station Union Vehicle Workshop and the southern outer detour onto one public master plate, so that no power's envoy can skip the inspection desk.

rules.from: Loss of the assigned records or a blocked handover may heighten concern about accountability.
rules.to: That a forged detour connects to the archive's rear door and joint bargaining becomes an empty phrase.

rules.from: Seeks continuity of the specific records entrusted to this person, rather than new authority.
rules.to: Has members claim losses against the same timetable, so that the Amsa blackout and the Yeouisin escort delay are not counted in different units.

rules.from: Loss of the assigned records or a blocked handover may heighten concern about accountability.
rules.to: That the joint bargaining ledger drops out of the Suseo Station box and only the powers' compensation slips survive.

rules.from: Seeks continuity of the specific records entrusted to this person, rather than new authority.
rules.to: Keeps the Suseo Station concourse as a southern window where contract, vote and audit are signed under one roof, so that no power's external control window can open on the platform.

rules.from: Loss of the assigned records or a blocked handover may heighten concern about accountability.
rules.to: That rumors of three drafts alone seal off the concourse and scatter members into rear-gate cart lines.

rules.from: Seeks continuity of the specific records entrusted to this person, rather than new authority.

rules.from: Loss of the assigned records or a blocked handover may heighten concern about accountability.

rules.from: Seeks continuity of the specific records entrusted to this person, rather than new authority.

rules.from: Seeks continuity of the specific records entrusted to this person, rather than new authority.
